notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 4 additional levels to the main story.
[*] Added 2 new enemy types
[*] Fixed bug that caused the first enemy bullet shot in slow motion to have significantly higher speed
[*] Changed scene transitions to be automatically destroyed based on player feedback.
[*] Balance changes to the following levels based on feedback: (15) Skyline, (16) Trucker's Rally, (17) Warzone Part 1, (25) Lagoon, (28) Onslaught.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the game to break when pausing at the end of a level.
[*] Fixed lag spike that would occur if a section was complete while holding certain weapons.
[/list]
